children: ) announced today that its Board of Directors declared a quarterly common stock dividend of $0.13 per share, reflecting an 18% increase from the prior quarterly dividend of $0.11 per share. The dividend is payable in cash on December 7, 2026 to stockholders of record as of November 20, 2026.

Named one of America’s Greatest Companies and America’s Most Responsible Companies by Newsweek and one of America’s Best Companies and the World’s Best Companies for Sustainable Growth by TIME, Zurn Elkay Water Solutions is headquartered in Milwaukee, Wisconsin, and is a growth-oriented, pure-play water management business that designs, procures, manufactures and markets what we believe to be the broadest sustainable product portfolio of specification-driven water management solutions to improve health, hydration, human safety and the environment. The Zurn Elkay product portfolio includes professional grade water safety and control products, flow systems products, hygienic and environmental products, water heating and filtered drinking water products for public and private spaces. Learn more at zurnelkay.com.
